adjudication_summary: Source re-review resolved the activity parser failure by extracting all Table 1 MIC and cell-expression rows, reconciled APD6/DBAASP database records against the primary table, preserved the DBAASP MIC-target strain conflict, and replaced generic mechanism notes with source-located DMS/docking/conservation claims.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded source recovery reopened packet XML, extracted article PDF text, OA package member list, SI PDF text, SI XLSX workbook contents, figure captions, linked APD6/DBAASP JSONL rows, and merged sequence/assay CSV rows. No additional local activity/toxicity tables beyond primary Table 1 were found; SI XLSX is 23S rRNA MSA conservation data.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 rows are source-verified for Table 1 sequence/MIC/citation; DBAASP rows are retained as source_conflict because MIC values/sequences match but DBAASP labels DH5alpha whereas the paper MIC method specifies MRE600.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 extracted 19 source-supported activity/growth rows from Table 1 and methods. No hemolysis/cytotoxicity rows are reported in local material, so toxicity remains an empty nonblocking category rather than fabricated evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 accepts DMS probing as direct ribosome/rRNA interaction evidence and docking/MSA as supporting mechanism context; no membrane-disruption mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains complete-with-gaps structurally, but the owner-layer source review exhausted the relevant OA package SI PDF/XLSX and found no activity-blocking unrecoverable gap.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP linked assay rows record Escherichia coli DH5alpha; primary broth microdilution methods use Escherichia coli MRE600. Values and sequences are retained but full-row source_verified status is not used for those records.
No local XML/PDF/SI/database material reports hemolysis or cytotoxicity assays for these 2025 Onc variants; final toxicity_records is intentionally empty.
SI PDF contains peptide characterization/synthesis and supporting figures/tables; XLSX contains bacterial 23S rRNA MSA conservation scores, not MIC/toxicity values.
Onc14-propargyl MIC is primary-source supported in Table 1 and SI synthesis evidence, while APD6 embeds it as SAR text under AP05806 rather than a separate sequence record.
